description: This file provides an API client for making HTTP requests, including support for mock data, environment-based configuration, authentication headers, and JSON handling. It exports the 'apiFetch' function which is used to perform API calls, and contains internal functions for simulating mock responses.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, { method = 'GET', body, headers = {}, token } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the specified API endpoint, handling JSON serialization, authentication headers, environment URL, and mock functionality.

methods.name: mockFetch(path, { method = 'GET', body, token })
methods.description: Simulates API responses for specific endpoints for mock purposes.

methods.name: delay(ms)
methods.description: Creates a delay using setTimeout wrapped in a Promise.

ctags.name: apiFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetch(path, { method = 'GET', body, headers = {}, token } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: data
ctags.pattern: /^  try { data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { data = { raw: text }; }$/

ctags.name: delay
ctags.pattern: /^function delay(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }$/

ctags.name: raw
ctags.pattern: /^  try { data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { data = { raw: text }; }$/

fields.name: try { data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { data = { raw: text }; }
